raise_LiteLLM_exception: raise a LiteLLM exception with model, provider, retry count, and debug info for LLM API errors
handle_RateLimitError_retry: handle a RateLimitError by checking num_retries and max_retries to implement retry logic
catch_ContextWindowExceededError: catch a ContextWindowExceededError to detect when an LLM context window is exceeded and truncate input
handle_MidStreamFallbackError: handle a MidStreamFallbackError to recover from mid-stream LLM fallback with generated content
list_LITELLM_EXCEPTION_TYPES: list all LITELLM_EXCEPTION_TYPES to iterate over available LiteLLM exception classes for error handling
